interpretation.argument_errors: 인자는 LLM이 새로 생성했음. 긴 단일 keyword 문구의 검색 실패는 툴 선택 head 추가 학습만으로 해결 보장 불가. native와 cached-prefix 생성 경로 차이를 먼저 분리해야 함.
interpretation.reader_errors: 근거를 읽고도 다른 인물을 답한 사례는 최종 독해/관계 해석 문제도 포함. head만의 문제로 귀속하지 않음.
interpretation.training_size: 32문항111상태의 제한된 일반화는 가설이며 원인으로 확정하지 않음.

keyword_generation_clarification.generator: Both conditions use the LLM to generate argument contents; the action head did not concatenate keywords. Native LLM split terms in this case; the search handler does not split them.
keyword_generation_clarification.handler: Each keywords array item is matched as a complete literal substring, case-insensitively. Separate terms can match independently; the unmatched long phrase returned no results.
keyword_generation_clarification.decoding: Both use greedy decoding, so sampling randomness is not the explanation. Native generates the envelope; head forces a compact prefix and constrains JSON suffix generation.
keyword_generation_clarification.causal_limit: Prefix and JSON constraints are candidate mechanisms, not individually verified causes. Exact-prefix controlled comparison has not been executed.
keyword_generation_clarification.gt_clarification: Dataset GT supplies answer/evidence, not a unique gold tool trajectory; native actions are a comparison policy.
keyword_generation_clarification.next_diagnostic_only: Compare native and cached argument generation at identical frozen history, tool and exact native prefix; no experiment launched by this save request.
